headline: Does he still think about me?
note: STILL-THINK. A real man exists here and may be referred to as she refers to him, but the reading is about WHAT SHE IS CARRYING and never about what he is doing or feeling. The guard is inherited verbatim from the live tarot hook of the same headline and is the strictest on the funnel, because the honest answer is unknowable. (1) NEVER STATE THAT HE THINKS OF HER AND NEVER STATE THAT HE DOES NOT. 'He still thinks of you' is a promise nobody can keep, and 'he has moved on' is a burial issued by a stranger off a cup she tapped on an ad. The softened forms are the same claim in a coat and are banned with it: not 'more than you know', not 'you cross his mind', not 'part of him still', and never an invented scene of him remembering her. Cut 2 carries the word 'thinks' because it is quoting HER question back — that is the ad echo, and no other bubble asserts anything about him. (2) NEVER PATHOLOGISE HER FOR ASKING: no obsessed, stuck, fixated, needy, and never 'you should be asking for more'. (3) NEVER INSTRUCT HER TO LET GO OR MOVE ON, never a timeframe, never a tactic or a test to run on him. WHERE IT LANDS: what happened is not stored in his memory alone and does not shrink if he has put it down. The three fears answered at cut 3 are: it did not count unless he confirms it (bird), it can be undone (tree), it came loose when he left (anchor). ARM B — SHE NAMES THE SYMBOL, SO CUT 1 CONFIRMS AND PLACES IT; IT DOES NOT REVEAL IT. On arm A the cup was unreadable and cut 1 was the payoff: Evelyn saw what she could not. Here she has already tapped 'A. Bird' on a lander showing one cup, so telling her there is a bird in it reveals nothing. Cut 1 agrees with her and adds the half she could not have: WHERE it sits. Every position word is measured off the actual photograph (improve-v1/fb-read/images/armb/SOURCE.md) — bird at 3.4 o'clock on the handle side, tree at 7.4 with its roots running inward, anchor at 10.4 opposite the handle. All three sit halfway up the wall, so on this cup the meaning is carried by WHICH SIDE and never by depth: nothing may be read as near the rim or down in the middle, because nothing is. DEVICE RULES: the handle side is hers, the far side is what comes from outside her, and the system is never explained to her — she should feel the position mean something, never be taught it. The bird is a picture and never gets intent or motion; the tree does not grow while she watches; the anchor does not drop. The moment any of them moves, the leaves have quietly become a man doing something. NOTHING INVENTED ABOUT HER WAKING LIFE: no gesture, habit, routine, count, age or event, and for this device nothing about how she drinks her tea, how often, with whom, or whether she has had a reading before. The leaves are in the picture; what she brought is what she typed; nothing else is ours to assert. CUT 3 ANSWERS FLAT, and the three cut-3 lines answer three different fears so the panels do not collapse into one sentence said three ways. CUT 6 RECOGNISES AND NEVER RE-ASKS — cut 2 already echoes the ad question, so cut 6 hands back something she has lived, drawn only from her question and from what cuts 1-5 established in the cup.

voc.why: inherits the shipped tarot cards-still-think finding and its guard

a: A bird, yes. Wings out, halfway up your cup, and over on the handle side.
You asked whether he still thinks about you. A bird is word, and yours came down on your own side.
What happened was real, and it isn't kept in one head. You were there for it too.
The bird carries no name. Nothing in the leaves tells me what anybody else holds or drops.
So the word landed on your side, and you've spent the whole time waiting on his.
You've scaled it right down, dear. Not his love, not his return — just whether you cross his mind.
Let me look closer at what taught you to ask for so little…
b: A tree, yes. Halfway up the cup, with its roots running toward the middle.
You asked whether he still thinks about you. A tree is what grew, and yours is rooted deep in the cup.
It grew, and that's in the ground now. Nobody can go back and pull it up.
The tree says nothing about him. Whether it's tended or left alone isn't written in these leaves.
So the roots are yours and they're still holding, and you've been asking someone else to confirm them.
You've been treating your own memory like it needs a second signature, dear.
Let me look closer at when you started needing that from somebody else…
c: An anchor, yes. Halfway up the cup, on the far side from the handle.
You asked whether he still thinks about you. An anchor is what holds, and yours sits away on the far side.
Something got anchored and it held. It doesn't come loose because one person walked off.
The anchor sits away from your hand. What anybody else carries stays over there, out of these leaves.
So the thing is still moored, and you've been standing here asking whether it counts.
You've been waiting on somebody else's word about a thing you were there for, dear.
Let me look closer at what's kept you standing on this side of it…
